purpose: Bound a possible separate source-tag learning pilot; do not replace teacher Usage labels
selection_order: Within each source label, ascending SHA256 of '2753:' plus source_id; one existing metadata-group representative; retain the first N usable rows per label where N=min(150, usable counts of all three labels). No selection by model scores or manual image labels.
image_access: Reuse verified cached images; first source-listed URL; at most one HTTP-to-HTTPS scheme change; no guessed CDN paths, access bypass, or unofficial copies
required_exclusions: Failed response, invalid image, or explicit source constraints incompatible with the intended use
Exact-byte or decoded-image duplicates within the selected source subset
All-role teacher exact and established near-duplicate matches, including development, holdout, quarantine and prediction
Source metadata groups linked to excluded overlaps
Known conflicting occasion sets or accepted type assignments within metadata groups
source_rights_record: Preserve PromptCloud's CC BY-SA 4.0 dataset declaration, attribution, source URLs, hashes and changes; document the basis and limits for the actual image use. Current release metadata alone does not establish blanket photo redistribution rights.
stop_conditions: Any label has fewer than 100 retained groups after bounded access and duplicate checks
Download or product-attempt cap reached before minimum counts
Canonical split or source hashes change unexpectedly
